questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of adverb of manner.
options: He has just done his work.
He has done his work on my table.
questions.solution: Regularly – Adverb of frequency; Just – Adverb of time; Carefully – Adverb of manner

questions.question: We seldom or ever(a)/ go out these days(b)/ because it is too cold nowadays.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'seldom or never' in place of 'seldom or ever.' Explanation:- Yeh meaning based question hai. seldom if ever- kabhi-kabhar. seldom or never- na ke barabar

questions.question: The child was (a)/ gazing longingly (b)/ at the toy.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: no error. Explanation:- longingly = adverb (chahat ke sath.)

questions.question: Though he was brave (a)/ he could not face the ups and downs (b)/ of life manly.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'manfully/like a man/ in a manly manner' in place of 'manly'. Explanation:- Yahan 'could not face' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki need hai aur 'manly' ek adjective hota hai.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of adverb of frequency.
options: Radha goes to Nagpur with great affection.
Radha goes to Nagpur for her office work.
Radha goes to Nagpur to meet her uncle.
questions.solution: Explanation:- often- Adverb of frequency (aksar)

questions.question: He was fortunately (a)/ not present on (b)/ the rostrum when (c)/ the bomb exploded.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'Fortunately, he was' in place of 'He was fortunately.' Explanation:- kyunki 'fortunately' yahan sentence adverb hai isliye sentence ke shuru mein use hogi.

questions.question: This room is very (a)/ beautiful but too much (b)/ small to accommodate (c)/ all of you.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'much too' in place of 'too much.' Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'small' adjective ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki need hai. too much = adjective; much too = adverb

questions.question: He always (a)/ aimed highly (b)/ in life.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'high' instead of 'highly'. Explanation:- high(adjective) – ooncha. Eg. the house has a high wall. high(adverb) - ooncha ya value ya amount mein zyada. he jumped very high. You should aim higher in life. highly(adverb) - very, in praise. he is highly successful. he speaks highly of you. (wo tumhari bahut tareef karta hai)

questions.question: Hardly he likes (a)/ to hear my name (b)/ after the rift which occurred (c)/ between him and me.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'Hardly does he like' in place of 'Hardly he likes.' Explanation:- kyunki ye sentence 'hardly' adverb se shuru hua hai isliye inversion ka use hoga.

questions.question: Bobo was (a)/ very richer than Jim (b)/ as he had illicitly accumulated (c)/ all his wealth. (d)
questions.solution: use 'much' instead of 'very'. Explanation:- kyunki comparative degree ko qualify karne ke liye 'much' ka use kiya jaata hai aur positive degree ke liye 'very' ka.

questions.question: Although he only earns (a)/ six hundred rupees a month (b)/ he manages to support (c)/ his family.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'earns only' in place of 'only earns'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan meaning ye dena hai ki wo sirf 600 rupees kamata hai.

questions.question: Her concerts (a)/ are very admired (b)/ by the foreigners. (c)/no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'much' instead of 'very'. Explanation:- kyunki very adverb kabhi verb ko qualify nhi karta. eg. he talks very. ( wrong) he talks much. ( right) Exception :- kuchh past participles ke sath bhi 'very' lagaya jaate hai. Eg. very tired, very dejected, very contented, very discontented, very pleased, very drunk, very delighted etc.

questions.question: I am (a)/ quite absolutely (b)/ fine so I don't (c)/ need your help.(d)
questions.solution: remove 'absolutely' after 'quite.' Explanation:- kyunki 'quite' apne aap mein ek absolute adverb hai iske sath aur adverb nahi lagate.

questions.question: He was (a)/ paid handsomely for (b)/ his ability to handle (c)/ the crowd skillful.(d)
questions.solution: use 'skillfully' instead of 'skillful'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'handle' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki need hai 'skillful' ek adjective hai aur 'skillfully' ek adverb hai.

questions.question: I never remember (a)/ to have met a more intelligent (b)/ man in my life.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'I remember never to have met a more intelligent man in my life.' or 'I don't remember to have met a more intelligent man in my life.' in place of 'I never remember to have met a more intelligent man in my life'. Explanation:- Yeh meaning based error hai. I never remember to have met a more intelligent man in my life. = main kabhi yaad nahi rakhta aise intelligent aadmi se milna meri zindagi mein. I remember never to have met a more intelligent man in my life. = mujhe yaad hai main kabhi nahi mila isse zyada intelligent aadmi se meri zindagi mein. I don't remember to have met a more intelligent man in my life. = mujhe yaad nahi ki main mila hun isse zyada intelligent aadmi se meri zindagi mein.

questions.question: He does not (a)/ know how to (b)/ draw quickly (c)/ and straightly.(d)
questions.solution: use 'straight' instead of 'straightly'. Explanation:- kyunki adjective and adverb form dono straight hi hoti hain.

questions.question: The man was (a)/ reportedly upset (b)/ over his sister's death (c)/ about a fortnight behind.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'ago' in place of 'behind.' Explanation:- kyunki past indefinite ke sath 'ago' ka use hota hai aur iske sath time bhi diya hai. 2 months ago; 5 hours ago

questions.question: She is quiet a generous woman (a)/ to have donated (b)/ such a large amount (c)/ for the flood affected people.(d)
questions.solution: use 'quite' instead of 'quiet'. Explanation:- Quiet (adj) - making very little noise. Quite (adv) – completely.

questions.question: Rarely we have seen a leader (a)/ who could respond to severe criticism (b)/ as calmly and mature as the current director. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'Rarely have we seen' instead of 'Rarely we have seen'. Explanation: Yahan inversion wala concept lagega. Yahan 'Rarely' adverb se sentence ki shuruaat huyi hai, Isliye verb ko inverted form me likhenge helping verb subject se pahle aayegi isliye ye structure use hua hai.

questions.question: She is (a)/ the very ambitious woman (b)/ I have ever (c)/ come across.(d)
questions.solution: use 'most' instead of 'very'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan iss woman ka comparison un sab women se ho rha hai jinse 'I' matlab speaker aaj tak mila hai isliye superlative degree ka use hoga.

questions.question: This world is (a)/ very much cruel to one (b)/and all of us , however (c)/ we love to live it at best.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'very cruel' in place of 'very much cruel.' Explanation:- cruel positive degree ka adjective hai iske sath 'much' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: He was enough tall (a)/ to be admitted (b)/ into the armed forces.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'tall enough' instead of 'enough tall'. Explanation:- kyunki 'enough' adverb ka use adjective ke baad kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Of course , you are going (a)/ to be a winner, (b)/ if you continue to work (c)/ with the same spirit.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'Certainly' in place of 'Of course.' Explanation:- certainly- koi kaam jiske hone ki bahut zyada 'probability ho. of course- koi cheez jo obvious ho. Eg. You will certainly pass the exam, you study hard. Of course blood is thicker than water.

questions.question: The helicopter of the enemies (a)/ hovered exact (b)/ over their bunker. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'exactly' instead of 'exact'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'over the bunker' adverbial phrase of place ko qualify krane ke liye ek adverb ki need hai isliye 'exactly' adverb aayega na ki 'exact' adjective.

questions.question: I presently received (a)/ a piece of news and (b)/ it is so shocking that I do not (c)/ want to break it to others.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'I have just received' in place of 'I presently received.' Explanation:- kyunki sentence ka meaning yeh dena hai ki news just abhi mili hai. Presently ka british English ke according meaning 'soon' hota hai jo ki future action ke liye use hota hai.

questions.question: The child was irritable (a)/ because she had not (b)/ soundly slept (c)/ the previous night.(d)
questions.solution: use 'slept soundly' instead of 'soundly slept'. Explanation:- kyunki 'adverb of manner' ka use intransitive verb mein 'verb' ke baad hota hai.

questions.question: He is too intelligent (a)/ to handle the (b)/ situation in a (c)/ successful manner.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'intelligent enough' in place of 'too intelligent'. Explanation:- 'too' ka use 'zarurat se zyada' (negative sense) mein karte hain. Yahan positive mein paryapt wala meaning dena hai isliye 'enough' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The old man (a)/climbed (b)/seven floors with hardly no effort (c)/at all.(d)
questions.solution: use 'any' instead of 'no'. Explanation:- kyunki 'hardly' aur 'no' dono negative words hain Dono ek sath use nahi kiye jayenge, isliye 'hardly' ke baad ek neutral word 'any' lagana padega.

questions.question: My last journey was (a)/ none too pleasant and i enjoyed (b)/ the alluring sights of flora and  fauna (c)/ through the tinsel window pan.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'only too' in place of 'none too.' Explanation:- none too = not very; only too = very

questions.question: So hoarse (a)/he was that he could (b)/not make the speech.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use was he in place of he was. Explanation:- yahan inversion ka use hoga.

questions.question: We should (a)/ keep our belongings (b)/ orderly.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use in an orderly manner in place of orderly. Explanation:- Yahan 'keep' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki need hai but 'orderly' ek adjective hota hai. Islfye 'in an orderly manner' adverbial phrase ka use hoga.

questions.question: Aarav's mother (a)/ speaks four languages (b)/ fluently.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: no error. Explanation:- 'speak' verb ke liye 'fluently' adverb ka use hua hai. Iss sentence mein koi error nahi hai.

questions.question: She does her (a)/ work good as she (b)/ is a trained nurse.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use well in place of good. Explanation:- verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki need hai isliye 'well' adverb ka use hoga. good = adjective; well = adverb

questions.question: The birds flew (a)/ fastly above (b)/ as we stood (c)/ on our terrace.(d)
questions.solution: use 'fast' instead of 'fastly'. Explanation:- kyunki 'fast' ki adjective and adverb form 'fast' hi hoti hai. Isiliye yahan sahi answer 'fast' hoga.

questions.question: You will find everybody (a)/ saying that it is (b)/ the much best movie (c)/ ever made in the Indian film industry.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'much the best' or 'by far the best' in place of 'the much best.' Explanation:- superlative degree ki intensity badhane ke liye 'much the' ya 'by far the' ka use hota hai. Isiliye yahan 'much the best' or 'by far the best' dono ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The thief (a)/ entered the house, (b)/ in the middle of the night, (c)/ quiet.(d)
questions.solution: use 'quietly' instead of 'quiet'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'entered' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki need hai 'quiet' ek adjective hai aur 'quietly' ek adverb hai.

questions.question: Not only we lost (a)/ what we had on our disposal (b)/ but we also (c)/ lost our patience.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'did we lose' in place of 'we lost'. Explanation:- 'not only' se sentence start hua hai isliye aage inversion ka use hoga.

questions.question: The careful crafted personality (a)/ of Anahita (b)/ did not help her much (c)/ in the electoral campaign.(d)
questions.solution: use 'carefully' instead of 'careful'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'crafted' past participle (semi verb) ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki need hai, 'careful' ek adjective hai aur 'carefully' ek adverb hai.

questions.question: He asked me to (a)/ completely forget her (b)/but only I know (c)/ how easy it is to say so.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'to forget her completely' in place of 'to completely forget her'. Explanation:- kyunki infinitive ko split nahi karte aur adverb of manner 'completely' jo forget ke liye aaya hai usse 'forget' ke object 'her' ke baad use krenge.

questions.question: The students (a)/ and the teachers (b)/ worked hardly (c)/ to make the event a success.(d)
questions.solution: use 'hard' instead of 'hardly'. Explanation:- Hard - with a lot of physical or mental effort: Hardly - only just; almost not

questions.question: Only by working (a)/ hard you can (b)/succeed in this exam.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'can you succeed' in place of 'you can succeed'. Explanation:- adverb of manner se shuruaat hui hai aage inversion ka use hoga. Isilye yahan pr 'can you succeed' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: You must avoid riding in a crowded bus (a)/ or travelling in a metro (b)/ during rush hour (c)/ as both are quiet unpleasant experiences.(d)
questions.solution: use 'quite' instead of 'quiet'. Explanation:- Quiet (adj) - making very little noise. Quite (adv) – completely.

questions.question: She makes often these (a)/ types of mistakes that's why (b)/ Mrs. Gomati always shouts at her. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use often makes in place of makes often. Explanation:- kyunki 'often' indefinite adverb of frequency hai jiski position verb se pehle rakhi jaati hai.

questions.question: Deepu's mother (a)/ has repeated asked him (b)/ to lower the volume (c)/ of his mobile.(d)
questions.solution: use 'repeatedly' instead of 'repeated'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'asked' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki zarurat hai 'repeated' ek adjective hai aur 'repeatedly' ek adverb hai

questions.question: She reacted (a)/yesterday very strangely (b)/ when I told her that I (c)/ had won a lottery. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'yesterday very strangely' with 'very strangely yesterday'. Explanation:- correct sequence of adverbs MANNER - PLACE – TIME

questions.question: We are (a)/ yet living (b)/in the (c)/same house.(d)
questions.solution: use 'still' instead of 'yet'. Explanation:- kyunki 'yet' ka use negative sentence mein kiya jaata hai aur 'still' ka use affirmative sentence mein kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Nobody has (a)/ ever listened (b)/ to me (c)/ so attentive. (d)
questions.solution: use 'attentively' instead of 'attentive'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'listened' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki zarurat hai 'attentive' ek adjective hai aur 'attentively' ek adverb hai.

questions.question: No matter (a)/ he tries hard (b)/ he cannot (c)/ play the guitar.(d)
questions.solution: use 'No matter how hard he tries' instead of 'No matter he tries hard'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan sentence ka meaning ye hai ki ' koi farq nahi padta wo kitna bhi try kar le wo guitar nahi seekh sakta. isliye 'no matter how hard he tries' ka use hoga.

questions.question: They can't hardly believe (a)/ that Article 370 (b)/ is no longer valid (c)/in Jammu and Kashmir.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'can hardly believe' or 'can't believe' in place of 'can't hardly believe'. Explanation:- kyunki 'double negative' ek sath use nahi krte hai ye superfluous bann jate hai. Isiliye yahan pr 'can hardly believe' or 'can't believe' ka use krenge.

questions.question: Found in many parts (a)/ of India, the frangipani tree is (b)/ a small, low – branching tree (c)/ which is especial used for several medicinal purposes.(d)
questions.solution: replace 'especial used for several medicinal purposes' with 'used especially for several medicinal purposes.' Explanation: use 'especially' adverb. Especially ek adverb hota hai aur yahan 'khaas taur se' wala meaning dena hai 'for medicinal purposes' ke liye isliye 'especially' ka use hoga.

questions.question: She loved herself (a)/ so more that she (b)/ thought of no one else.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'much' instead of 'more'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan koi comparison nahi hona hai isiliye comparative degree 'more' nahi lagegi. Iske alawa yahan 2 hint aur hai 'so' adverb positive degree adjective ke liye aati hai aur 'so' ke sath 'that' ka pair hota hai isiliye yahan pr 'so that' se bnayenge.

questions.question: I know that (a)/ he wanted to (b)/ go home earliest.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'early ya at the earliest' instead of 'earliest'. Explanation:- early - jaldi; at the earliest- jitna jaldi ho sake.

questions.question: He has never (a)/ supported me,(b)/  nor you have.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'nor you have' with 'nor have you'. Explanation: 'nor have you' negative statement ka addition to statement structure "neither/nor + helping verb + subject" banta hai.

questions.question: This is a most (a)/ important chapter so you (b)/ should study it carefully.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: no error. Explanation:- Yahan is chapter ka kisi aur chapter se comparison nahi hai isliye yahan superlative degree ka use nahi hoga. 'most' adverb ka matlab 'very' bhi hota hai. this is a most important chapter = this is a very important chapter. Note:- agar ye sentence esa hota. this is a most important chapter in your syllabus.... tab iss chapter ka comparison syllabus ke baaki chapters se mana jaata aur tab 'a most' ki jagah 'the most' ka use karte.

questions.question: Hardly we had boarded the train when it started to move.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Ye inversion topic pe based question hai. Sentence ke shuru mein 'hardly' lga hai isliye partial inversion lagega matlab helping verb subject se pehle ayegi. isliye D option 'Hardly had we boarded' sahi hai.

questions.question: There are so many children at the party that it was hardly impossible to keep a count.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'hardly' ka matlab hota hai 'na ke brabar' aur ye ek negative word hai isliye iske sath 'impossible' jo khud bhi ek negative meaning ka word hai wo nhi aa sakta. isliye option B and D galat hai. A option galat hai kyuki possible ya impossible word ke baad generally 'infinitive' lga kr structure bnaya jata hai. Isliye C option ' hardly possible to keep a count' sahi hai.

questions.question: I went to Paris regularly.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Question mein past indefinite 'went' ka use hua hai isliye C option 'yesterday' best hai. Baki options ko na choose karne ke aur bhi reasons hain jaise ki 'twice' ke sath generally present perfect tense aata hai , 'often' ki position verb se pehle hoti hai 'happy' adjective hai aur humhe yahan adverb ki jarurat hai isliye ye bhi galat ho jayega but 'went' ki wajah se 'yesterday' best option hai.

questions.question: The new shop that opened last week are hardly sufficient stock of the products that it advertised about.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'shop mein na ke brabar hi sufficient stock tha' matlb possession type ka meaning hai jiske liye 'have' verb ki forms ka use hota hai. Have jab possession ko show karti hai toh stative verb hoti hai iski 'ing' nhi use hogi isliye C option galat hai. D option 'is had' grammatically galat hai. A option isliye galat hai kyuki hardly ke sath not nhi aata. Isliye B option 'hardly had' sahi hai

questions.question: He led me to the room that had obvious been built later than the rest of the house.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan ek adverb ki jarurat hai isliye option B and C galat hai kyuki wo nouns hai. A option meaning se galat hai. kyuki 'obliviously' means doing something in an unaware state. isliye D option 'obviously' grammatically and meaning ke according sahi hai.

questions.question: He was too glad to meet his friend after a long time.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'too' means more than what is required' isliye generally ye negative meaning dene ke liye use hota hai but yahan positive meaning dena hai isliye D option galat hai. Intensity badhane ke liye jab 'so' ka use hota hai toh baad mein 'that' aata hai isliye B option galat hai. C option grammatically galat hai. Isliye A option 'very glad' sahi hai.

questions.question: He did not admit that his team played badly.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Question ki heading mein likha hai ki adverb of frequency choose karna hai isliye 'A option' jisme 'never' hai wo sahi hai.

questions.question: No sooner did this idea enter his head, than it carried conviction with it.
options: No sooner does this idea enter
No sooner do his idea enter
No sooner has his idea enter
questions.solution: Explanation:- Aage ka sentence past mein hai isliye no sooner wala part past mein rahega isliye question mein diya gya ' no sooner did this idea enter' grammatically sahi hai.

questions.question: Shyama does not laugh, nor she smiles.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Ye inversion ke concept pe based question hai. yahan 'nor' lga ke ek negative statement ke liye addition to statement wala structure likhna hai jisme inversion lgta hai isliye C option 'nor does she smile' sahi hai.

questions.question: Caffeine is a diuretic that makes you urinate more often.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Question mein dia gya 'more often' adverb of frequency hai 'urinate' verb ke liye. yahan comparative degree isliye lagi hai kyuki yahan with caffeine and without caffeine ki situation mein comparison hai. Baki options grammatically galat hai.

questions.question: The family can none long stay in their big house.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'wo family ab unke bade ghar mein aur nhi ruk sakti thi' iske liye 'no longer stay ' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Viren examined careful all the possibilities of data theft.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan examined verb ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai. 'Carefully' adverb hota hai aur 'careful' adjective. isliye A option 'Carefully examined' ka use hoga. Note :- waise adverb of manner ki position object ke baad ya agar object bda ho toh verb se pehle hoti hai but yahan aisa koi option nhi hai toh A option hi best hai.

questions.question: The books has become enormously popular with students who do not like to read.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Subject 'books' plural hai isliye verb bhi plural ayegi aur popular adjective ko qualify karne ke liye adverb lagegi. isliye D option 'have become enormously popular' sahi hai. Note :- Ye soch ke confuse na hon ki 'become' linking verb ke baad toh adjective aana chahiye tha. Become linking verb ke baad aane wala adjective 'popular' hai bas adjective se pehle adverb 'enormously' ka use ho gya hai.

questions.question: He knows how bad I wanted a baby.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'wo janta hai kitna jada jaruri hai mere liye ek baby' 'badly' adverb ka ek use ye bhi hai - emphasise how much you need or want something. isliye A option 'how badly I wanted..'sahi hai

questions.question: Peter is studying hard to have score in the exams.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Action ka purpose btane ke liya ya keh sakte hain verb se 'why' ka reply dene ke liye generally infinitive ka use kiya jata hai. iss case mein ye infinitive ek adverb ki tarah kaam karta hai. Isliye C option 'to score' sahi hai.

questions.question: When we reached the hill station, it was raining the heaviest.
questions.solution: Explanation: Yahan 'raining' verb ke liye adverb ki requirement hai aur koi comparison nhi karna hai isliye A option 'heavily' sahi hai.

questions.question: Though many of my family members can cook well, I can cook more well than others.
options: I can cook best than others
I can cook more good than others
I can cook good than others
I can cook better than others
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yahan cook verb ko qualify karne ke adverb chahiye aur comparison bhi karna hai isliye 'well' ki comparative degree 'better' ka use hoga isliye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: The king's palace was heavily guarded during the riots.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan guarded ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai isliye question mein diya gya 'heavily guarded' sahi dia hai.

questions.question: That tree fell down yesterday narrowly miss my car.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Ye question bhut students ka doubt rehta hai. yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'wo paed kal gir gya meri car ko narrowly miss karta hua' yahan 'missing' present participle ka use hoga jo ki tree ke liye aya hai kyuki 'paed gira car ko narrowly miss karta hua' ye meaning dena hai. Note:- A option 'narrowly miss' galat hai kyuki yahan koi verb nhi chahiye kyuki koi conjunction nhi hai. B option 'narrowly missed' isliye galat hai kyuki missed past participle hai jo passive ki sense deta hai ya receiver ke liye lgaya jata hai jabki tree ke liye lgana hai jo miss karne ka doer hai.

questions.question: Suman performed at the festival well yesterday.
questions.solution: Explanation:- adverb ke sahi sequence Manner - Place - Time hota hai (MPT rule) isliye C option sahi hai.

questions.question: You will have to pay heavy for your crimes.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sahi structure :- 'Have' form + to + VB 'hota hai aur verb ke liye adverb lagegi isliye B option 'to pay heavily' sahi hai.

questions.question: Sheela was reprimanded for  coming lately to school.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Lately - haal filhaal mein. Late - deri se. Meaning and grammar ke according yahan B option sahi hai.

questions.question: He only married her for her money.
options: Only he married her for her money.
He married only her for her money.
He married her only for her money.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yahan sentence ke according sahi meaning ye hoga ki 'usne sirf paison ke liye usse shadi ki' aur iss meaning ke liye D option sahi hai.

questions.question: I want you to clearly understand the situation.
options: clearly you to understand the situation
you to understand the situation clearly
to understand you clearly the situation
questions.solution: Explanation:- Ye split infinitive pe based question hai. 'Clearly' adverb of manner ' to understand ' ke liye aaya hai aur adverb of manner ki position transitive verb ke case mein object ke baad hoti hai isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: He did not know the Answer , I did not neither.
questions.solution: Explanation:- ye Inversion ke concept pe based question hona. yahan ek neither statement ke liye addition to statement likhna hai jisme inversion ka use hoga. isliye B option 'neither did I' sahi hai.

questions.question: He behaved like coward.
questions.solution: Explanation:- A option galat hai kyuki yahan behaved verb ke liye adverb chahiye aur 'cowardly' ek adjective hai. B option galat hai kyuki 'manner' noun ko qualify karne ke liye 'cowardly' adjective hona chahiye tha. D option 'like coward' galat hai kyuki 'coward' ek noun hota hai aur singular countable noun se pehle yahan 'a' article hona chahiye tha. Isliye C option 'like a coward' sahi hai. ye pura ek adverbial phrase of manner banega 'behaved' verb ke liye.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of adverb of manner.
options: He finished the task on time.
He completes the assignment every day.
He is working on the assignment at the new site.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'he completed the assignment efficiently'. Explanation:- Option A sahi hoga kyunki 'efficiently' adverb of manner hai, option B mein 'on time' adverb of time hai, option C mein 'every day' adverb of frequency hai, option D mein 'at the new site' adverb of place hai.

questions.question: He seldom or ever (a)/ visits his relatives (b)/ during the festival season (c)/ as he hates social gatherings (d).
questions.solution: replace 'seldom or ever' with 'seldom or never'. Explanation:- 'seldom or ever' jaise koi adverb nahi hoti. 2 adverb hoti hai 'seldom if ever' ka matlab 'kabhi kabaar', 'seldom or never' ka matlab 'naa ke barabaar', sentence mein bataya ki 'usse social gathering se nafrat hai', isliye yahan 'seldom or never' sabse sahi adverb hogi.

questions.question: Though she is intelligent (a)/ she could not handle (b)/ the challenges in her career confident.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'confident' with 'confidently'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'confident' ki jagah 'confidently' ayega kyunki 'handle' verb ke liye adverb of manner ki jarurat hai, 'confident' adjective hota hai, isliye yahan 'confidently' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Select the sentence with the appropriate use of adverb of frequency.
options: She works at the hospital with full dedication.
She works at the hospital to help the patients.
She usually works at the hospital from 9 am to 5pm.
She works at the hospital with her friends.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'she usually works at the hospital from 9am to 5pm'. Explanation:- Option C sahi hoga kyunki 'usually' adverb of frequency hota hai. option A mein 'with full dedication' adverb of manner hai. option B mein 'to help' adverb of reason hai. option D mein koi adverb nahi hai.

questions.question: They were luckily (a)/ not travelling in the train (b)/ which met with an accident (c)/ last night (d).
questions.solution: replace 'they were luckily' with 'luckily, they were'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'luckily' starting mein ayega kyunki 'fortunately, generally, luckily' yeh 'sentence adverb' hoti hai jo kisi word ko nahi poore sentence ko qualify karne ke liye likhi jaati hai, isliye inhe starting mein likhte hai, toh 'luckily, they were' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I know this dress looks very (a)/ elegant but it is too much (b)/ tight to wear (c)/ comfortably (d).
questions.solution: replace 'too much' with 'much too'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'tight' word adjective hai, adjective ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hoti hai, 'too much' adjective hota hai aur 'much too' adverb. Isliye yahan 'tight' adjective se pehle 'much too' adverb sahi hoga.

questions.question: Since her birth, her parents (a)/ have always encouraged (b)/ her to aim highly (c)/ and never give up. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'highly' with 'high'. Explanation:- Iss sentence mein 'highly' ki jagah par 'high' ayega kyunki 'highly' adverb hoti hai jiska matlab 'bahut jyada', aur 'high' bhi adverb hoti hai jiska matlab 'uncha' hota hai, toh sentence ka matlab hoga 'uncha aim karna aur kabhi haar naa maanna', toh sahi meaning ke liye 'high' adverb sahi hogi.

questions.question: Hardly they visit (a)/ their relatives (b)/ after the dispute (c)/ that arose over the property last year(d).
questions.solution: replace 'hardly they visit' with 'hardly do they visit'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'hardly' ke baad 'do' helping verb ayegi, kyunki partial inversion mein helping verb subject se pehle aati hai. agar sentence ki starting 'seldom, hardly, scarcely, rarely etc.' adverb of frequency se hoti hai toh inversion follow hota hai jisme 'verb' subject se pehle aati hai. isliye yahan 'hardly' ke baad 'do they' sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: This smartphone is (a)/ very costlier than the previous model (b)/ because of its advanced features (c)/ and upgraded camera system (d).
questions.solution: replace 'very' with 'much'. Explanation:- Comparative degree adjective ki intensity badhaane ke liye 'much, far' adverb ka use kiya jata hai, isliye yahan 'very' ki jagah 'much' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Although she only earns (a)/ a few hundred rupees every month (b)/ yet she manages to pay (c)/ her child's school fees and household bills (d).
questions.solution: replace 'only earns' with 'earns only'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'only' ki position galat hai kyunki, sentence mein batana hai ki 'wo sirf kuch hundred kamati hai har mahine', isliye 'only' 'earns' ke baad ayega. aur 'only earns' se matlab niklega ki 'wo kamati hai', toh sahi matlab ke liye ' earns only a few hundred' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She was very praised (a)/ by the teachers (b)/ for her dedication and hard work (c). no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'very praised' with 'praised a lot, praised highly'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'praised' se pehle 'very' adverb nahi ayegi, kyunki 'very' adverb ka use generally adjective ke sath hota hai, yeh verb ko qualify karne ke liye nahi aata. Isliye 'praised' ki intensity badhaane ke liye 'praised a lot, praised highly' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She was (a)/ quite completely (b)/ sure about her decision (c)/ to move abroad for higher studies (d).
questions.solution: remove 'completely'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'completely' ka use nahi hoga kyunki 'quite' adverb ka matlab hee 'completely' hota hai, toh 'quite' ke sath 'completely, absolutely' galat hote hai, aur yeh superfluous ki category mein aate hai, isliye sentence mein 'quite' ke sath 'completely' ka use galat hoga.

questions.question: She was (a)/ rewarded generously for (b)/ her efforts to manage (c)/ the entire event efficient (d).
questions.solution: replace 'efficient' with 'efficiently'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'efficient' adjective ki jagah par 'efficiently' adverb ayegi kyunki 'to manage' infinitive hai jisme 'verb' bhi hoti hai, verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hoti hai, isliye yahan 'efficiently' adverb sahi hoga.

questions.question: I never remember (a)/ to have seen a more dedicated (b)/ teacher in my entire life (c)/. No error (d).
questions.solution: replace 'never remember' with 'don't remember, remember never'. Explanation:- 'I never remember' se meaning ho jayega ki 'mai kabhi yaad nahi rakhta' joki sahi meaning nahi hai. yahan meaning dena hai ki 'mujhe yaad hai mein kabhi nahi mila', 'yaa mujhe yaad nahi ke mein kabhi mila hoo', yeh do meaning sahi nikal sakte hai, jiske liye 'I don't remember, I remember never' ka use kare. Note:- jab 'I remember never' likhte hai toh 'never' aage likhe 'to have seen' perfect infinitive mein aayi verb ki liye 'adverb' ka kaam karta hai.

questions.question: She does not even (a)/ know how to cut the fabric (b)/straightly so I won't be able (c)/ to hire her(d).
questions.solution: replace 'straightly' with 'straight'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'straightly' ki jagah par 'straight' ayega kyunki kuch words 'straight, right, late, fast, low etc.' aise hote hai jinka adjective aur adverb form same hoti hai, isliye yahan 'straight' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He is a quiet talented musician (a)/ who has composed (b)/ many beautiful melodies (c)/ without any formal training (d).
questions.solution: replace 'a quiet talented' with 'quite a talented'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'quiet' ki jagah 'quite' ayega, kyunki 'quiet' ka matlab 'shaant', aur 'quite' ka use intensity badhaane ke liye aata hai. agar 'quite' ke baad adjective hai toh simply 'quite + adjective' sahi hota hai, lekin agar 'adverb+adjective' ke baad noun hota hai toh 'quite' article ke pehle chala jaata hai, toh sentence mein 'musician' noun hai, isliye 'quite a talented musician' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He told me that his brother (a)/ who is a soldier got injured (b)/ in a battle (c)/ about six months behind (d).
questions.solution: replace 'behind' with 'ago'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'behind' ki jagah par 'ago' ayega kyunki 'behind' preposition hoti hai, aur 'koi cheez itne time pehle hui' yeh batane ke liye 'ago' adverb ka use hota hai, isliye yahan 'ago' adverb sabse sahi hogi.

questions.question: People praised (a)/ his several (b)/ attempts fearlessly (c)/ to rescue the children trapped inside the bus (d).
questions.solution: replace 'attempts fearlessly' with 'fearless attempts'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'praise' karne waali baat uske 'attempts' ke liye likhi hai, toh sentence mein 'attempts' noun hai jisko qualify karne ke liye adjective ki jarurat hai, toh 'fearless' adjective hota hai jo ki noun se pehle ayega, isliye 'fearless attempts' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She was not enough confident (a)/ to deliver the speech (b)/ in front of such a huge audience (c)/ no error (d).
questions.solution: replace 'enough confident' with 'confident enough'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'enough confident' ki jagah par 'confident enough' ayega, kyunki 'enough' ek aise adverb hai, jis adjective ko qualify karti hai uske peche aati hai, toh 'confident' adjective hai, isliye yahan 'confident enough' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The city has become (a)/ very much noisy these days (b)/ because of the constant traffic jams, (c)/ though people have learnt to adjust somehow (d).
questions.solution: replace 'very much' with 'very / too'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'noisy' ek positive degree adjective hai aur 'much' adverb ka use comparative degree adjective se pehle hota hai naa ki positive degree adjective ke liye, isliye 'noisy' ki intensity badhaane ke liye 'too' yaa 'very' adverb sahi hogi, toh 'too noisy, very noisy' dono sahi answer honge.

questions.question: She is (a)/ the very intelligent student (b)/ I have ever (c)/ taught in my teaching career (d).
questions.solution: replace 'very' with 'most'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'very' ki jagah par 'most' ka use hoga kyunki sentence mein ek bacche ka comparison sab bacchon se karna hai, jiske liye superlative degree ka use hoga. 'more intelligent' comparative degree hoti hai, 'most intelligent' superlative degree hoti hai, isliye yahan ' the most intelligent' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The principal almost punished every student (a)/ who was involved in the violent argument (b)/ during the annual function. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'almost punished' with 'punished almost'. Explanation:- Yahan meaning ye dena hai ki principal ne punish kia almost har ek student ko, 'almost' yahan 'every' adjective ko qualify karne ke liye aaya hai tho uski position every se pehle honi chahiye thi.

questions.question: Of course, you will get (a)/ a promotion soon, (b)/ if you keep working (c)/ with the same level of commitment (d).
questions.solution: replace 'of course' with 'certainly'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'ofcourse' ki jagah par 'certainly' ayega kyunki 'jab koi cheez future mein hogi' yeh batane ke liye 'certainly' ka use karte hai aur 'of course' ka use 'koi obvious baat ke liye' karte hai, sentence mein 'will' se pata chal raha ki 'promotion future mein hoga, isliye yahan 'certainly' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I have presently got to know (a)/ that Shalini is moving abroad, (b)/ but I am not able to decide (c)/ how to react to this news (d).
questions.solution: replace 'presently' with 'recently'. Explanation:- 'presently' ka matlab hota hai 'jaldi hee, soon', lekin sentence ke meaning se pata chal raha ki 'usse abhi hee pata chala hai ki shalini abroad jaa rahi hai', toh 'abhi hee' waale matlab ke liye 'recently' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Many drones were seen flying exact (a)/ above the army base (b)/ during the early hours (c)/ of the operation (d).
questions.solution: replace 'exact' with 'exactly'. Explanation:- 'exact' adjective hota hai, lekin sentence mein 'above' preposition hai jisko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat  hai, isliye yahan adverb 'exactly' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Ravi looked tired (a)/ as he had not (b)/ properly slept (c)/ for the last two nights (d).
questions.solution: replace 'properly slept' with 'slept properly'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'properly' adverb of manner hai aur adverb of manner, agar transitive verb ho toh object ke baad lagte hai, agar object nahi ho toh verb ke baad lagte hai, isliye 'properly' adverb verb ke baad ayega, isliye 'slept properly' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The young athlete completed the marathon (a)/ with hardly no sign of fatigue (b)/ even after running continuously (c)/ for more than four hours (d).
questions.solution: replace 'no sign' with 'any sign'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'no' ki jagah 'any' ayega kyunki 'hardly' pehle hee negative word hai jiske baad ek aur negative 'no' galat hoga, isliye 'no' ki jagah neutral word 'any' ayega, isliye 'hardly any sign of fatigue' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: So tired (a)/ he was that he could (b)/ hardly keep his eyes open (c)/ during the late-night meeting (d).
questions.solution: replace 'he was' with 'was he'. Explanation:- Agar kisi sentence ki starting mein 'so +adjective/adverb of manner' ho toh inversion ka use karte hai, aur inversion mein 'verb' 'subject' ke pehle aati hai, isliye 'was he' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Don't worry your student is too brave (a)/ to face the challenges of this (b)/ competition without any help (c). no error(d)
questions.solution: replace 'too brave' with 'brave enough'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'too brave' ki jagah 'brave enough' ayega kyunki 'too……to' ka structure negative sense mein aata hai, lekin sentence mein positive baat kehni hai jiske sath 'too' galat hoga. Toh jisme infinitive bhi aa raha ho aur positive baat karni ho, toh uske liye 'enough' ka use karte hai, isliye 'brave enough to face' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The weather during our vacation was (a)/ only too pleasant so we had to cancel (b)/ several outdoor plans (c)/ despite booking everything in advance (d).
questions.solution: replace 'only too' with 'none too'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'only too pleasant' se matlab hoga ki 'vacation ke dauran mausam accha tha', agar mausam accha hota toh plan thodi cancel karte, toh sentence ke according negative word chaiye isliye 'none too' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Among all the novels written by her, (a)/ this one is said to be (b)/ the much greatest achievement (c)/ of her career (d).
questions.solution: replace 'the much' with 'by far the/much the'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'the much' ki jagah 'by far the/much the' ayega kyunki superlative degree ki intensity badhaane ke liye agar 'much' ka use karte hai toh 'much, by far' ko 'the' ke pehle likhte hai, isliye 'by far the/much the' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The chef performed (a)/ very good in the competition (b)/ despite the limited ingredients (c)/ available in the kitchen (d).
questions.solution: replace 'very good' with 'very well'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'good' ki jagah 'well' ayega kyunki 'performed' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai, 'good' adjective hota hai aur 'well' adverb hota hai, isliye yahan 'very well' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The workers were instructed (a)/ to keep the tools (b)/ orderly before leaving (c)/ the construction site every evening (d).
questions.solution: replace 'orderly' with 'in an orderly manner'. Explanation:- Kuch words jaise 'orderly, manly, godly, lively etc.' yeh adjectives hote hai, lekin sentence mein adverb ki jarurat hai, isliye 'orderly' ki jagah 'in an orderly manner' adverbial phrase of manner ka use karenge.

questions.question: Only when the storm (a)/ was over we could (b)/ see the extent of (c)/ the destruction around us (d).
questions.solution: replace 'we could' with 'could we'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'we could' ki jagah 'could we' ayega kyunki 'only' ke sath jab time diya ho, yaa clause laga ke time bataya jaaye, toh yeh inversion ka kaam karta hai, jisme verb subject se pehle aati hai, isliye yahan 'could we' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The farmers (a)/ worked hardly (b)/ throughout the summer (c)/ to save their dying crops (d).
questions.solution: replace 'hardly' with 'hard'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'hardly' ki jagah 'hard' ayega kyunki 'hardly' ka matlab hota hai 'naa ke barabar' jo ki adverb hota hai, aur 'hard' adjective aur adverb dono hota hai, sentence mein meaning dena 'mehnat' wala, isliye yahan 'hard' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The beautiful painted mural (a)/ on the old temple wall (b)/ attracted many tourists (c)/ in the cultural festival (d).
questions.solution: replace 'beautiful' with 'beautifully'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'painted' adjective ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai aur 'beautiful' bhi adjective hota hai, toh adjective mein 'ly' lagane se adverb ban jata hai, isliye yahan 'beautifully' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Not only he broke (a)/ the traffic rules (b)/ but he also (c)/ argued with the police officer (d).
questions.solution: replace 'he broke' with 'did he break'. Explanation:- Yahan sentence ki shuruaat 'Not only' se ho rahi hai jiske saath inversion use kia jaata hai, Isliye yahan par 'he broke' ki jagah 'did he break' aayega.

questions.question: They are yet hoping (a)/ that the situation will (b)/ improve when the (c)/ new policy gets implemented (d).
questions.solution: replace 'yet' with 'still'. Explanation:-Sentence mein 'yet' ki jagah 'still' ayega kyunki 'yet' ka use perfect tense mein karte hai aur generally negative yaa interrogative mein karte hai, sentence continuous mein likha hai aur positive sense mein hai, isliye yahan 'still' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The manager shouted (a)/ in the meeting very angrily (b)/ when the team failed to answer(c)/ his questions (d).
questions.solution: put 'very angrily' before 'in the meeting'. Explanation:- 'very angrily' 'in the meeting' ke baad ayega kyunki isme 'Manner, Place, Time' ka structure follow ho raha hai, jiske according 'very angrily' Manner, Time se pehle ayega, isliye 'very angrily in the meeting' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: He forgets usually (a)/ to carry his ID card (b)/ to the examination centre (c).No error (d)
questions.solution: put 'usually' before 'forgets'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'usually' manner of frequency hai jisko verb se pehle likhte hai jaise 'often, seldom, always, rarely etc' yeh verb se pehle aate hai aur 'daily, weekly, monthly etc' yeh clause ke end mein aate hai, isliye yahan 'usually forgets' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The villagers trusted (a)/ the new leader so more that (b)/ they followed all his instructions (c)/ without any question (d).
questions.solution: put 'usually' before 'forgets'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'more' ki jagah 'much' ayega kyunki 'more' ek comparative degree hai lekin sentence mein koi comparison nahi karna, isliye yahan positive degree 'much' ayega aur 'so' 'much' ki intensity badhaane ke liye aaya hai .

questions.question: It was a most enjoyable evening and everyone (a)/ praised the host for arranging (b)/ such a pleasant get-together. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: no error. Explanation:- 'a most' ka matlab 'very' hota hai.

questions.question: You will be surprised (a)/ to know that she hasn't apologized (b)/ for her rude behaviour, nor her brother has (c)/ No error (d).
questions.solution: put 'has' before 'her brother'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'addition to statement' ka structure follow ho raha hai jisme negative sentence mein 'neither/nor + helping verb + subject' ka structure follow hota hai, isliye yahan 'has her brother' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: No matter she works how sincerely, (a)/ she never gets appreciated (b)/ for her efforts. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: put 'how sincerely' before 'she works'. Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'koi farak nahi padta ki wo kitni sincerely kaam kare' iss type ke meaning ke liye yeh structure use hota hai 'no matter how sincerely she works'. Example - 'no matter how hard he try', 'no matter how early I come' iss type ke meaning ke liye yeh structure use hota hai. isliye 'how sincerely' 'she works' se pehle ayega.

questions.question: Neem leaves are often used in making soaps (a)/ which are specially very effective (b)/ in preventing skin infections. (c)/ no error (d).
questions.solution: replace 'specially very effective' with 'very effective especially'. Explanation:- 'specially' ka matlab 'koi special tarika' aur 'especially' ka matlab 'koi particular'. Sentence mein 'neem soaps' ki baat ho rahi aur particularly skin infection ko prevent karne mein, isliye yahan 'very effective especially' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The audience clapped when the singer graceful bowed at the end of her mesmerizing performance.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein 'bowed' verb ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai aur 'graceful' adjective hai, isliye diye gaye options mein se 'gracefully' adverb sabse sahi answer hoga. 'gracefulness' aur 'graciousness' noun hai aur 'gracious' adjective hai.

questions.question: The students were too happy to see their favourite teacher return after a long medical leave.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'too…….to' ka structure negative meaning convey karta hai, lekin sentence mein positive baat karni hai, aur matlab dena hai 'students bahut khush the', isliye yahan 'very happy' option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She did not agree that her decision had hurt her close friends who had supported her for years.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein adverb of frequency pucha hai, 'yesterday agreed' adverb of time hai, 'willingly agreed, happily agreed' adverb of manner hai, isliye diye gaye option mein se option A 'never agreed' adverb of frequency sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Hardly we had reached the examination hall when the final bell rang, and everyone rushed to their seats.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai aur inversion follow hota hai, jisme verb subject se pehle aati hai, isliye diye gaye options mein se option C 'had we reached' inversion sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: No sooner did the students finish their final exams, than they began planning for a long vacation.
options: No sooner do the students finish
No sooner have the students finished
No sooner had the students finishing
questions.solution: No substitution

questions.question: Even though both my sisters dance gracefully, I can perform more well than both of them on stage.
options: I can perform more good than both of them
I can perform good than both of them
I can perform best than both of them
I can perform better than both of them
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein ek ka comparison dono sisters se karna hai aur yahan 'sisters' ek unit maane gaye hai, isliye yahan superlative degree nahi balki comparative degree ayegi, isliye 'well' ki comparative degree 'better' sahi hogi, isliye option D 'better than both of them' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The old bridge became so weak that vehicles could none long cross it safely during the monsoon.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein jab kehna ho ki 'ab hum aage nahi jaa sakte', iske liye 'no longer' phrase ka use karte hai, isliye yahan option A 'no longer cross' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The teacher observed close how each student responded during the practical exam.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein 'observed' ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai aur 'closely' adverb hota hai, isliye option B aur C galat honge. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki koi habitual action ki baat nahi karni. Isliye option A 'closely observed' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Drinking too much green tea can act as a mild diuretic, making your body release water more often.
questions.solution: No improvement

questions.question: The students presented their dance in the auditorium beautifully last night.
options: beautifully in the auditorium last night
last night beautifully in the auditorium
in the auditorium last night beautifully
beautifully last night in the auditorium
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein Manner, Place, Time ka structure follow hoga, isliye option A 'beautifully in the auditorium last night' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The speeding truck lost control on the highway, narrowly missing a group of school children crossing the road.
questions.solution: No substitution

questions.question: They only invited their close friends to the private ceremony.
options: They invited only their close friends to the private ceremony.
They invited their only close friends to the private ceremony.
Only they invited their close friends to the private ceremony.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein 'only' adverb hai jo yahan 'their' adjective ko qualify kar raha hai, isliye 'only' 'their' ke pehle ayega, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The soldier ran away from the battlefield like coward.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein adverb ki jarurat hai, jo ki adverbial phrase of manner se banega jise 'in a cowardly manner' yaa 'like a coward' likhenge, isliye diye gaye options mein se option B 'like a coward' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The officer ordered the guards to immediately close the gates.
options: the guards to close the gates immediately
the guards immediately to close the gates
to the guards close immediately the gates
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein 'immediately' ki position galat hai kyunki yeh 'infinitive' ko split kar raha hai, isliye 'immediately' ko last mein likhenge, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The journey was comfortable but the bit tiring than I thought it would be.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein comparison karna hai ki 'jitna socha tha usse jyada', isliye yahan 'more' ayega aur 'thoda sa' ke liye 'a bit' phrase use hota hai, isliye yahan 'a bit more tiring' option D sabse sahi answer hoga.
